note: Videogame adaptation: starting loadout, issued automatically (the player does not choose gear). Book (Core p.141 (CL p.137)) only lists standard issue for conversion to Star Trek Adventures: uniform, communicator, tricorder, and a sidearm (phaser type-1 or type-2 for security and senior officers). The per-department loadouts below are the approved prototype design, keyed by the career department. Applied in order: base items, the tricorder, the sidearm, then the department, then the assignment (if listed). 'tricorder' replaces the default tricorder; 'add' appends items.

sidearm.source: Core p.141: all Starfleet personnel receive a phaser type-1 as standard; all security personnel, and all senior officers (lieutenant commander and higher rank), receive a phaser type-2 instead. Civilian characters do not receive a sidearm.
sidearm.note: Implementation pick (Oct 2026): a character counts as Starfleet when their Career Path category is listed in starfleetCareerPaths, or when they hold any officer or enlisted rank (a diplomat or civilian who took a rank, cf. Core p.123). Security personnel = the Security department. Senior officer = an officer rank at or above seniorOfficerMinRank.
